title: Dense Subset Sum in Multi-Dimension
summary: We study the additive structure of dense subset sum in multi-dimension, and use the structure to develop efficient algorithms for the dense subset sum problem. More precisely, given a set $A$ of $n$ vectors in the $d$-dimensional hyperrectangle $[N_1]\times [N_2]\times\cdots\times [N_d]$, we study the structure of $\mathcal{S}(A)$, which is the set of all subset sums of $A$. We focus on the dense regime of the problem where $n \gg \sqrtΦ$ and $Φ= N_1 \times \cdots \times N_d$.
